name: PAPZIMEOS
indications_original: PAPZIMEOS is indicated for the treatment of adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis.
contraindications_original: PAPZIMEOS is for subcutaneous injection only. ( 2.1 ) The recommended dose of PAPZIMEOS is 5×10 11 particle units (PU) per injection administered by subcutaneous injection four ( 4 ) times over a 12-week interval. ( 2.1 ) Prior to the initial administration of PAPZIMEOS, perform a surgical debulking of visible papilloma to establish minimal residual disease. To maintain minimal residual disease during treatment with PAPZIMEOS, remove visible papilloma, if present, prior to the third and fourth administration of PAPZIMEOS. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Each carton of PAPZIMEOS (NDC 84768-511-01) contains one single-dose vial (NDC 84768-511-99) of PAPZIMEOS sterile frozen suspension.

                        PAPZIMEOS is supplied in a single-dose vial made from cyclic olefin polymer (COP) with a rubber stopper and aluminum flip-cap seal. Each vial is sealed inside a pouch (NDC 84768-511-00). The pouch is placed in the container along with a Package Insert. Each vial is formulated to contain an extractable dose of 5×1011 PU in a 1 mL suspension.
